get.description:
List mobile workers in a project space, or fetch a single mobile worker by identifier. Mobile workers are the users who submit forms from CommCare mobile or web apps.

Requires the `edit_commcare_users` permission.

parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return. Use 0 to request all records.
parameters.name: limit

eulas.description: End user license agreements the user has accepted.

groups.description: List of all group IDs belonging to the user.

id.description: User UUID.

locations.description: A list of location IDs that the user is assigned to.

phone_numbers.description: List of all phone numbers of the user.

primary_location.description: The location ID of the primary location of the user.

require_account_confirmation.description: If True, creates an unconfirmed account (similar to a deactivated account). False by default. Write-only: not returned in the response.

resource_uri.description: URI of this record in the API.

send_confirmation_email_now.description: If True, immediately sends an account confirmation email. False by default. Write-only: not returned in the response.

user_data.description: Any additional custom data associated with the user.

username.description: User name of user, including domain, for example "jdoe@example.commcarehq.org".
